Scenic-element channels (Eos Scenic_Element*, e.g. the revolve) dropped from cues/presets: Scenic_Element 186, Scenic_Element_Movable 1170, Preset 19

Blocked values (TRACK_TYPE b/B) are kept as plain values; a channel whose rows are ALL blocked carries PARAMS `blk: true` (a hard copy of the tracked state, not a move). Cue-level BLOCK is kept as `block`. In a cue with parts, Eos stores blocked (b) and mark (M) rows outside any part: they are the cue's own `ch`; a mark part (mark: true, usually part 20 "Mark") gives the marks' timing.

Mark (move-in-dark) values: TRACK_TYPE M rows; PARAMS `mark` names the cue they are pre-set for. Cue/part `mark: true` = Eos M/m (this cue moves lights in the dark); `marked: true` = Eos R (some of this cue's values were pre-set by an earlier mark).
Zoom: Eos stores degrees (ranges: Viper 10-44, Viper 91-100 10-55, X4 7-49.2, VL3500 10-50).

Gobo rotation: Gobo_Wheel_Mode 25 read as INDEX (goboIdx degrees, goboRot 0), 63/76 as ROTATE with the value taken as RPM (goboRot = 6 x value, raw in goboSpd). Evidence: mode 25 carries per-fixture angles like -167.8/-100.8/-67.6/0.9 on a Linear gobo in a "shutter in" palette (an alignment, not a speed); but the "spin" palettes (bp 52/76/80) are also mode 25 with values near +-50, so those spins may come from effect 355 "GOBO <>" or may mean mode 25 is rotate. MEDIUM-LOW confidence; RPM unit is a guess.

Gobo_Select 6.4 cannot be learnt (beam palettes 107-114 label it Pebbles/Iris/Blocks/Tribal/Leaves/Alpha/Open alike) -> "slot:6.4". Beam palettes 101-106 (25 Vipers) disagree with 2-7 (all 35 Vipers); the vote follows 2-7. Viper 91-100 and VL3500 slots other than open are unlearnt.
Colour wheel (Color_Select) is emitted as cw "slot:N" (0.5 = "open"); names unknown.
LED Cyan (S4 Lustr) is emitted as `cyan` (0-100); CMY fixtures use `cmy`.
Diffusion is emitted as `frost` 0-100. Strobe, shutters/framing, animation wheel, beam fx, X4 pixel mask and mode params are dropped.
Per-parameter FADE_TIME/DELAY_TIME (discrete timing) are folded to the channel as PARAMS `time`/`delay` (max over that channel's parameters).
Group membership comes from the Group rows' TIME_DATA column (the Eos export puts the channel list there); bracketed sub-groups are kept as `sets`.
Focus: X/Y/Z_Focus mapped to set-local metres; Pan/Tilt kept as Eos degrees.
